title: Ego-Forge: Text and Geometric-Attention Free Exo-to-Egocentric Video Generation
title_zh: ego-forge: 无需文本和几何注意力的外视角到第一视角视频生成

paragraphs.en: Exo-to-egocentric video generation aims to synthesize what a person sees from their own viewpoint given third-person footage and a target head trajectory. The task requires transferring appearance and semantics across large viewpoint changes while hallucinating content never observed by the exocentric camera. Existing approaches either impose additional input requirements, such as a ground-truth initial egocentric frame or multiple synchronized exocentric views, or remain limited to category-specific settings. EgoX is the first to address cross-activity and in-the-wild generalization, but requires a human-provided caption of the non-existent egocentric view at inference and introduces a computationally expensive geometry-guided attention bias that can propagate reconstruction errors and suppress textual and visual context. We therefore propose \textbf{Ego-Forge}, a caption-free and bias-free framework for exo-to-egocentric generation. It introduces \textit{Dynamic Captioning}, which derives conditioning tokens directly from the model's hidden states and adapts them to the diffusion timestep and network depth, replacing external text conditioning. By scaling training by an order of magnitude and using all available exocentric viewpoints, Ego-Forge learns cross-view correspondence implicitly and eliminates the need for geometry-guided attention, requiring only a lightweight depth prior. Ego-Forge achieves state-of-the-art performance on Ego-Exo4D, runs faster end-to-end, requires no external annotation at inference, and generalizes to in-the-wild scenes, including cases where over-reliance on geometry blocks appearance inference. Our model and source code will be made publicly available.
paragraphs.zh: 从外视角到自我视角的视频生成旨在根据第三人称视频和目标的头部轨迹，合成一个人从自身视角所看到的内容。 该任务要求在视角发生巨大变化时传递外观和语义信息，同时生成外视角摄像头从未观察到的内容。 现有方法要么施加额外的输入要求，例如真实初始自我视角帧或多个同步的外视角，要么仅限于特定类别的设置。 EgoX 首次解决了跨活动和自然场景中的泛化问题，但在推理时需要人类提供不存在的自我视角的说明，并引入了计算成本高昂的几何引导注意力偏差，这种偏差可能传播重建错误并抑制文本和视觉上下文信息。 因此，我们提出了 \textbf{Ego-Forge}，一个无需说明且无偏差的外视角到自我视角生成框架。 它引入了 \textit{动态说明生成}（Dynamic Captioning），直接从模型的隐藏状态中推导出条件标记，并根据扩散时间步和网络深度对其进行调整，从而替代外部文本条件。 通过将训练规模扩大一个数量级并利用所有可用的外视角，Ego-Forge 能够隐式地学习跨视角对应关系，并消除了对几何引导注意力的需求，仅需一个轻量级的深度先验。 Ego-Forge 在 Ego-Exo4D 数据集上实现了当前最优性能，端到端运行速度更快，推理时无需外部标注，并能泛化到自然场景，包括那些过度依赖几何信息而阻碍外观推断的情况。 我们的模型和源代码将向公众开放。
